headline.intro: At Healthy & Happy, we believe better nutrition can create healthier people, happier lives, and stronger communities. We create nutritious, plant-based, high-protein food products that make healthy living more accessible, practical, and enjoyable — while creating positive impact for our communities and farmers.

values.title: Healthy
values.description: We believe good health starts with better everyday nutrition. We create nutritious, plant-based food products designed to support a healthier lifestyle.

values.title: Happy
values.description: Healthy living should be enjoyable, not complicated. We make nutritious food that brings convenience, confidence, and happiness to everyday life.

values.title: Responsible
values.description: We believe our impact goes beyond our customers. By working with farmers and supporting responsible food production, we aim to create value throughout the entire food system.

history: Established in 2017 in the vibrant city of Mandalay, Myanmar, Healthy & Happy Myanmar Co., Ltd. was founded by three visionary women entrepreneurs and a pioneering nutritionist.

Our journey began with a deeply personal story. One of our co-founders experienced the heartbreak of losing her father to cancer due to a lack of access to nutritious food. This profound experience ignited a passion to ensure no one else would suffer from preventable health issues due to poor nutrition.
Recognizing the prevalence of diabetes and other health conditions in our community, we committed ourselves to making a difference—one nutritious product at a time.
